candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately before performing any calls (single-statement replacement of the 'return true;' statement).
Return the success status of the last external call instead of always true (replace final return with returning the boolean from the last call).
Return whether the first external call succeeded (replace final return with returning the boolean from the first call).
Insert an early return of true before the loop, causing function to always return true without performing calls.

Change the call target selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) -> transferFrom(address,address,uint256) was original; mutant replaces selector with transfer(address,address,uint256) so the called ABI selector differs, altering external observable behavior.

Replace the external low-level call with a direct call to caddress.transferFrom(...) via a function type call encoded using solidity's abi.encodeWithSignature, changing the ABI encoding and thus observable behavior when called.
Change loop to stop before final element (i < _tos.length - 1) so fewer transfers are executed, altering observable post-call state.
Change require(_s) to require(!_s) so the function reverts when the external call succeeds, altering whether state changes from the external calls are observable after completion.
